title: LLV-GBANKQ25: linear classical space at the quarter-source envelope

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the one physical LLV-GBANKQ25 interpreter of proof.md executing the complete virtual.md program recovers the whole secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. On EVERY branch fully charged work is O(2^(sqrt(n)log2(n)+4sqrt(n)(log2(n))^(1/4))), with an absolute outside constant and exact growth index1/2. The virtual program is the fixed lambda=1, centered slope-ell low-source profile, with every original guard, failed attempt, decoder and finite branch preserved. The explicit fixed-region basis bank, complete bit/address decoding, source SWAP moves, all measurements/resets, prefix initialization and cleanup cost at most a fixed polynomial times virtual work plus polynomial startup. Virtual14 supplies the stronger internal exponent sqrt(n)log2(n)+2sqrt(n)log2log2(n)+O(sqrt(n))+O((log n)^2), whose strict eventual gap absorbs all added polynomial overhead into the exact stated envelope. All five claims apply jointly to this same physical configuration. The selected complete virtual program is LLV-GBRQ25 with m=floor((v-256ell)/(2D)), not the bank source's larger-source profile; all original caps and finishing cases are preserved.

For the same physical LLV-GBANKQ25 algorithm and every N,s on EVERY branch, peak allocated classical workspace is O(n) bits with an absolute constant and exact growth index0. The counted controller retains N, output, a fixed number of O(n)-bit staged operands, short address/scan fields and finite code. Every other virtual label, array, frame, return context, loop/cap counter, arithmetic field, generator descriptor and allocator record is stored in the counted basis-qubit bank, with no duplicate classical stack or growing measurement transcript. Input/output coexist and are included. proof.md Sections2-6 establish the complete physical implementation, jointly with full-secret success and all other claims.

For this same physical LLV-GBANKQ25 algorithm and every N,s on EVERY branch, peak allocated quantum workspace is O(n^2) qubits, with an absolute constant and exact growth index0. Seven fixed packed virtual-classical regions of C*2^(2ceil(log2(n+2))) bits each, C=2^48, and fixed linear virtual-quantum pools bound maximum address spans independently of retry count. Virtual classical bit i is physical basis wire2i, virtual quantum q is wire2(q+1)+1, and the entire doubling paired prefix including unused padding is counted. All bank values, metadata, original coherent registers, fair-bit and temporary source scratch, allocation growth, failed work and cleanup are included. No per-bit keys/flags, coherent bank address or free QRAM is introduced. This is joint with unconditional full-secret success and all other claims.

For this same physical LLV-GBANKQ25 algorithm and every N,s on EVERY branch, all fresh acquired source copies number O(2^((1/4)sqrt n)), with an absolute outside constant and exact growth index1/2. The proved CQ simulation executes exactly one physical source request per virtual request and no others; bank/padding zero qubits are counted work and quantum memory, not DCP copies. Thus every rejected, failed, discarded and aborted copy is included, with exactly the virtual acquisition sequence and original guards. The literal main cap nCcap+K<=2^(sqrt(n)/4) and finite branch outside constants remain those fully proved in virtual.md. The unchanged output law gives unconditional full-secret success at least1-2^-8 jointly with every resource and error claim.

For this same physical LLV-GBANKQ25 algorithm/configuration, the guaranteed malformed-source fraction is epsilon(n)=0 under the exact independent-ideal-copy model. For every N>=2 and every secret, all acquired copies are independent ideal coset states and full-secret recovery succeeds with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 jointly with all four physical resource bounds. The bank simulation preserves the complete output and source law under this promise. Additional bank measurements may expose classical record bits under a different adaptive supplier model, for which no transfer or positive tolerance is claimed. Zero is not an impossibility assertion about greater robustness.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
